questions.question: Give two reasons why Philip II of Spain wanted to invade England. (4 marks)

points.text: Two reasons: (1) Religion - Philip was a devout Catholic who wanted to overthrow Elizabeth's Protestant settlement and restore Catholicism in England; (2) English support for the Dutch rebels - Elizabeth sent money and troops to help the Dutch Protestants fighting against Spanish rule in the Netherlands, which was a direct threat to Spanish power. questions.question: Explain why the fire ships were a turning point in the Armada campaign. (4 marks)

points.text: The fire ships were a turning point because they broke the Armada's tight defensive crescent formation, which had protected the fleet during the Channel battles. When the Spanish panicked and cut their anchor cables, they scattered and could not regroup. This made the Armada vulnerable to the English attack at the Battle of Gravelines the next day.
